solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Special band for the match

parts.note: a band worn on the finger, given at a match in the sense of a marriage rather than a sporting fixture

explanation.surface: A particular group of musicians is booked to play at a sports match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Band' suggests musicians and 'match' a game, but the band is a ring and the match a marriage.
explanation.definitionFit: The ring exchanged at a marriage ceremony is a special circular band marking that union.

clue.text: Line up on vessel for religious service

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a row is a line
a ship is a vessel

explanation.surface: People queue on a ship for a church service.
explanation.definitionFit: Formal praise of God in church is a religious service.

clue.text: Money comes in handy in China

indicators.note: comes in places the money letter within the next word

parts.note: deft means skilful, handy
L stands for pound, from libra, so money

explanation.surface: Cash proves useful when travelling in China.
explanation.walkthrough: 'China' looks like the country but is pottery: Delft is Dutch glazed earthenware.
explanation.definitionFit: This blue-and-white glazed pottery from the Netherlands is a kind of china.

clue.text: Divide into parts and bury division

parts.note: to inter is to bury
a sect is a division of a religious group

explanation.surface: Instructions to split something up and bury a faction.
explanation.definitionFit: Lines that cross divide an area into separate parts.

clue.text: Get a larger size

parts.note: read as buying bigger clothes, but it means to become bigger

explanation.surface: Shopping advice to try the next size up.
explanation.definitionFit: To increase in size or height is to become larger.

clue.text: Natural aptitude you'll need this month in court

parts.note: inst., instant, is the old business abbreviation for this month

explanation.surface: A gift for the law is needed in court this month.
explanation.walkthrough: INST (instant) was used in letters to mean 'of this month'.
explanation.definitionFit: An inborn feel for doing something is a natural aptitude.

clue.text: Enormous soldier — a six-footer

parts.note: GI is an American soldier
an insect has six legs, so an ant is a six-footer

explanation.surface: A huge soldier standing six feet tall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'six-footer' suggests a tall person, but it is an insect with six feet.
explanation.definitionFit: Something colossal or huge is enormous, an adjective synonym.

clue.text: You need inspiration to draw them

definitions.text: You need inspiration to draw them

parts.words: You need inspiration to draw them
parts.note: inspiration is literally breathing in, and to draw them means to inhale, not to sketch

explanation.surface: An artist needs creative inspiration before sketching.
explanation.definitionFit: Inhaling air is drawing these, and breathing in is inspiration.

clue.text: Mortification of girl attached to criminal band

indicators.note: the girl's name is joined on to the end of the band

parts.note: a gang is a criminal band
Rene is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A young woman is humiliated by her links to a gang.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mortification' looks like shame but is its medical sense: death of tissue.
explanation.definitionFit: In medicine, mortification is an old term for tissue death in part of the body.

clue.text: Accounts for all members of the family

definitions.meaning: accounts in the sense of narrated reports or tellings
kin, the people related to you

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both narratives (relating a story) and one's kinsfolk collectively.

clue.text: Humble sailor confronts rough sea

indicators.note: the sailor stands in front of, facing, the next piece

parts.note: AB, able-bodied seaman, is a common abbreviation for a sailor

indicators.note: rough sea churns the letters into a new order

explanation.surface: A modest seaman faces up to stormy waters.
explanation.definitionFit: To humble someone is to lower or degrade them, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Broken hearts may lead to lovers' converse

indicators.note: broken hearts are shattered, so the letters are reassembled differently

explanation.surface: Heartbreak can turn people who once loved into enemies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'converse' is the noun meaning opposite, not the verb to chat.
explanation.definitionFit: The opposite of people who love are people who loathe, so an antonym relation.

clue.text: Sure to be a song by drunk

parts.note: an air is a tune or melody
tight is informal for intoxicated

explanation.surface: Someone is certain to be a tune sung by a tipsy person.
explanation.definitionFit: An airtight argument or case has no flaws, so it is certain to hold.

clue.text: Pack up quietly and clear out

parts.note: P, piano, is the musical direction for playing quietly

indicators.note: out means the letters of clear are put out of order

explanation.surface: Someone quietly packs their things and leaves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'clear out' reads as a phrase meaning leave, but 'out' alone signals the rearrangement and 'clear' is its fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: To wrap something up into a package for posting is a verb synonym of pack up.

clue.text: Engineers commanding officer returned amid recent move to new area

parts.note: RE, Royal Engineers, is the British army corps

indicators.note: amid puts the turned letters inside the word for recent

parts.note: late means recent, as in the late news

indicators.note: returned means the officer abbreviation is turned back

explanation.surface: A recently returned officer moves the engineers to a new posting.
explanation.walkthrough: The Royal Engineers are a British army corps; 'returned' turns only the officer, which then sits 'amid' the word for recent.
explanation.definitionFit: Moving home or business to a different place is to resettle in a new area.

clue.text: Clears off temporary settler on board

indicators.note: on board places the camper within the ship's letters

parts.note: on board means aboard a ship; SS (steamship) stands for the vessel
a camper sets up home only for a short stay

explanation.surface: A short-stay holidaymaker on a ship clears off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on board' conventionally means inside SS, the abbreviation for steamship.
explanation.definitionFit: To run off hurriedly, in a scuttling way, is to clear off in a hurry.

clue.text: The farthest one will be from a bank

definitions.text: The farthest one will be from a bank

parts.words: The farthest one will be from a bank
parts.note: a river bank, not a financial bank: the point furthest from both shores

explanation.surface: Someone is as far as possible from any bank branch.
explanation.definitionFit: The middle of a river is the point most distant from either shore.

clue.text: Oriental girl that's charged — it gets thrown out

parts.note: E, east, means oriental
a miss is a girl
an ion is a charged particle

explanation.surface: An Eastern girl who has been accused is ejected.
explanation.definitionFit: Something discharged or given off, like exhaust gas, is thrown out.

clue.text: The rest of the players

parts.note: rest read as the interval break the players take, not the remaining members

explanation.surface: Someone asks about the remaining members of a team.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The rest' looks like 'the others', but it is a pause taken mid-game.
explanation.definitionFit: The interval in a match when the team leaves the pitch is their break from play.

clue.text: She is expected to succeed

parts.note: succeed in the sense of inheriting, following on, rather than doing well

explanation.surface: A woman tipped for success.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman due to inherit a fortune or title will succeed to it.

clue.text: Notice opening in time

parts.note: an ad is a notice or advertisement
a vent is an opening or outlet

explanation.surface: Someone spots a gap just in time.
explanation.walkthrough: The season before Christmas is the time defined.
explanation.definitionFit: The church season leading up to Christmas is a named period of the year.

clue.text: A treaty involved with food transport

indicators.note: involved means tangled up, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A treaty concerning shipments of food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'food transport' sounds like freight, but it is a small household item.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat carrier for taking cups and food from kitchen to table is a humble food transport.

clue.text: What's more it's a sincere reforming

indicators.note: reforming means re-forming, giving the letters a new shape

explanation.surface: Someone sincere is turning over a new leaf, and more besides.
explanation.walkthrough: 'What's more' looks like a link phrase but is the definition: a gain is something that is more.
explanation.definitionFit: A rise or addition is literally an amount that is more than before.

clue.text: Under redirection some of those letters went astray

indicators.note: some of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some letters went astray after being redirected.
explanation.walkthrough: 'those letters' refers back to the hidden run itself, making it the subject of the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To go astray is to stray from the right path, a synonym for making a mistake.

clue.text: Outrageous articles about Western capital

parts.note: OTT, over the top, means outrageous

indicators.note: the two articles go round the next letter

parts.note: A and A are two indefinite articles

explanation.surface: Shocking newspaper pieces about a Western capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: This city is the seat of government of Canada, so a national capital.

clue.text: Tree in a small enclosure

parts.note: a pen is an enclosure for animals

explanation.surface: A tree is growing inside a little fenced pen.
explanation.definitionFit: A poplar with trembling leaves is a kind of tree.

clue.text: Escape and feel different

indicators.note: different means the letters take a different order

explanation.surface: Getting away makes you feel different.
explanation.definitionFit: To run away from danger is to escape, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Accept an inviting suggestion

definitions.meaning: to admit or take in, as when you ... someone's name on a list
the one-word invitation called out to someone knocking at the door

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to admit or take in and the call telling a visitor to come in.

clue.text: Surliness I shall moderate

parts.note: I'll is the contraction of I shall
to temper is to moderate or soften

explanation.surface: A grumpy person resolves to calm down.
explanation.definitionFit: A bad mood shown as irritability is the same as sullen surliness.

clue.text: Supplementary benefit for workers lacking security

definitions.text: Supplementary benefit for workers lacking security

parts.words: Supplementary benefit for workers lacking security
parts.note: extra pay for hazardous work, with 'lacking security' meaning unsafe rather than unemployed

explanation.surface: A welfare payment for people without job security.
explanation.walkthrough: Supplementary Benefit was a British welfare payment; here it is just an extra payment for risky jobs.
explanation.definitionFit: Extra payment given to employees in hazardous jobs is a bonus for risk.
